constraints: Exactly 100000000 PW and all C00 allocation amounts remain unchanged
No native mint, extra genesis allocation or automatic funding
Safe refunds remain disabled; external sender pays native PW gas
No governance, Safe owner, timelock or emergency role granted to payer
Public metadata only; no keys, signatures or funding operation in this record
Every funding and subsequent transaction needs separate exact transaction approval
AVAX P-Chain fees require a separate AVAX payer and budget; PW is not AVAX
Remaining payer funds need an explicitly authorized reconciliation/return procedure

alternatives.description: A custodian of an existing approved C00 allocation pays initial EVM gas directly, or explicitly transfers a capped PW gas budget to a dedicated operator payer
requiredAuthority: Owner approves use consistent with that allocation purpose
Source custodian approves and signs any transfer
Owner approves payer, exact amounts, destination, chain and transaction scope
alternatives.limitations: Only viable if existing recipient can authorize/pay a transaction without another unfunded dependency. Do not assume team/liquidity/presale/rewards funds are unrestricted or available

alternatives.description: A separately authorized already-funded PW holder submits Safe execution transactions as external relayer, optionally all initial governance operations
requiredAuthority: Sponsor consents to capped native PW spending
Owner approves relayer scope and all governance payloads
Safe quorum separately authorizes each Safe transaction
alternatives.limitations: No existing sponsor or balance is asserted. Sponsor cannot approve Safe payloads or gain governance authority merely by paying gas. No automatic reimbursement

alternatives.description: After an external payer has bootstrapped scheduling/execution, treasury quorum may schedule a capped native PW gas-budget disbursement after at least 48 hours
requiredAuthority: Owner approves budget, recipient, scope and audit trail
External payer funds the initial transactions and waits for actual inner success
alternatives.limitations: Cannot solve the first unfunded transaction circularity. Uses existing treasury funds, never a new allocation. Not Safe refund bypass or instant treasury withdrawal

rejectedAssumptions: Treasury can pay its first external transaction itself
Emergency controller can withdraw bootstrap gas
Owner approval alone creates PW funds
Unallocated genesis gas reserve is available
Safe gas refunds may be enabled for convenience
